FAQ

The questions that recur, answered from the code and docs.

Do users need to install anything to activate the Telegram bot?

No. The owner creates the user in the panel and hands over the activation link (t.me/<bot>?start=<user-uuid>). The user taps Start once; the chat bound to that account thereafter shows /me and /ovpn. Users cannot extend or disable themselves.

Can a user extend their quota from Telegram?

No. Extend is owner-side by design: panel actions or the owner's /extend <user> <days> [gb] command. The user bot is read-only.

What happens when I delete a user or a node by accident?

You have 25 seconds to press Undo in the banner. After that the snapshot expires (410 Gone for users, Undo window expired for nodes). There is no undo after 25 seconds by design.

Why does the panel use a random URL path?

It hides the panel identity from internet scanners. It is not authentication; the owner login (bcrypt hash in the database) is the gate. ovmanager urlpath prints the path.

What if I forget the owner password?

Reset it from the server; user data is untouched: sudo ovmanager reset-password. The value is never logged.

Node says red in the panel?

Check, in order: address (public IP), sync port (2083, not 1194), API key (exact, no spaces), TLS switch matching the node, name equality with OVN_NAME, and firewall 2083/tcp. Full table: Troubleshooting → Node stays red.

Where is my data?

Panel: /var/lib/ovmanager/app.db (SQLite). Node PKI and OpenVPN config: /var/lib/ovnode/openvpn/server/. Node agent data: /var/lib/ovnode.

How do I back up and restore?

ovmanager backup writes a verified bundle; the daily timer keeps it fresh. Test one restore before you need it — Backups & restore.
